Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

Claim 2 (Currently Amended): The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem.

Claim 3 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has a length that is variable and is adapted to extend from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus. 

Claim 22 (Currently Amended): The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw.
